title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

As our HRBP, you will own the end-to-end HR experience for our site. Your goal is simple but vital: create a \"positive ecosystem\" where zero production loss occurs due to ER issues, and every employee feels aligned with the Royal Enfield values.


Responsibilities

  • Ensure all HR records and documents of the employees are maintained and updated
  • Roll out relevant induction programs for new joiners

  • Identify training needs for employees and enable the learning and development initiatives, and create suitable L & D plan

  • Assist with resolving employee relations issues and address grievances
  • Develop initiatives to promote employee well-being and to increase employee engagement

  • Ensure adherence to all applicable statutory and labour laws of the unit and compliance with all relevant statutes
  • Drive uninterrupted Business delivery by creating a positive ecosystem and ensuring no production loss due to Employee Relations issues
  • Monitor and ensure zero deviation in attendance & payroll process, successful implementation of Digitization and HR projects
  • Maintain harmonious industrial relations and ensure zero productivity loss due to IR issues


Who you are? Experience/ Qualifications:

  • Communicator: You are fluent in English and possess strong conflict-resolution skills.
  • Tech-Savvy: You have excellent IT and reporting skills; you love a good metric!
  • Local Expert: You have a deep understanding of statutory regulations and Brazilian labor laws.


Royal Enfield - About Us:

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’25, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 18,870 crore s which is approximately USD 2.23 billion.

title: Gerente Regional de Vendas
description:
A Fugini é uma empresa brasileira de alimentos, líder nos segmentos de molhos de tomate e vegetais, que iniciou sua trajetória há quase 30 anos na cidade de Monte Alto, interior de São Paulo. Com atuação totalmente voltada ao mercado nacional, seus produtos estão presentes em todas as regiões do país. Atualmente, a companhia opera com duas unidades fabris equipadas com modernos sistemas de automação: uma em Monte Alto (SP) e outra em Cristalina (GO), inaugurada em 2010 e com 33 mil metros quadrados de área construída. Guiada pelos pilares de inovação, sustentabilidade, saudabilidade e excelência, a Fugini foi pioneira no lançamento de embalagens do tipo sachê para a linha de atomatados - uma das mais eficazes e seguras para a preservação dos alimentos - e a primeira no mundo a embalar vegetais nesse formato. Comprometida em oferecer produtos saudáveis e com rótulo limpo (clean label), a empresa não utiliza conservantes artificiais e promoveu a redução de sal, açúcar e gordura na maioria de suas formulações. Seu portfólio inclui molhos de tomate, vegetais em sachês e latas, molhos especiais, condimentos e outros itens desenvolvidos sob rigorosos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Para saber mais, acesse fugini.com.br.


O que buscamos:

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias comerciais para o canal direto e indireto (pequeno, médio e grandes redes varejistas e atacados de pequeno e médio porte).
  • Planejar e executar campanhas promocionais, garantindo performance e presença no ponto de venda.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de vendas e propor ações para otimização de resultados.
  • Gerenciar relacionamento com clientes e fortalecer parcerias;
  • Analisar contratos comerciais e garantir sua conformidade com as diretrizes da empresa;
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento, expansão geográfica e ampliação de portfólio no varejo alimentar.
  • Apoiar na estruturação de equipe, direta e indireta em novas regiões.
  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar a equipe de Gerentes de Área de Vendas.
  • Residir em Belo Horizonte ou Contagem no estado de Minas Gerais.



Principais Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada na indústria alimentar e no canal direto no estado de Minas Gerais.
  • Domínio de gestão operacional e indicadores de performance.
  • Fluência no uso de ferramentas digitais e aplicativos para gestão e análise.
  • Noções de tributação fiscal no estado de Minas Gerais.
  • Mobilidade para mudança de estado com a família.

Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

Segmento: Ensino Fundamental II 

Prazo de Inscrição: 30 de abril de 2026

Principais responsabilidades: Planejar, ministrar e desenvolver aulas de Inglês para estudantes do Ensino Fundamental II, promovendo o desenvolvimento das habilidades de leitura, escrita, escuta e oralidade. Estimular o pensamento crítico, a comunicação e o desenvolvimento socioemocional dos alunos, por meio de abordagens investigativas e centradas no estudante. Trabalhar com diferentes gêneros textuais e estratégias pedagógicas, incluindo leitura guiada, produção textual, projetos e discussões estruturadas. Utilizar práticas avaliativas diagnósticas, formativas e somativas para acompanhar o progresso dos alunos, oferecer feedback contínuo e diferenciar o ensino para atender a diferentes perfis de aprendizagem, incluindo estudantes multilíngues. Colaborar ativamente com a equipe pedagógica no planejamento curricular. Manter uma comunicação efetiva com famílias, sempre alinhado ao currículo, às diretrizes institucionais e à filosofia educacional da escola.


Requisitos: Licenciatura em Letras-Inglês. Fluência em inglês. Experiência docente, preferencialmente em contextos bilíngues ou internacionais. Capacidade de atuar de forma eficaz com estudantes de diferentes contextos culturais. Habilidades de comunicação, resolução de problemas e organização. Familiaridade com ferramentas e plataformas de tecnologia educacional. Mestrado será um diferencial.


Envie seu Currículo, sua carta de apresentação e uma carta de referência profissional para o nosso departamento de Recursos Humanos no endereço até 30 de abril de 2026.


Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.


Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.


Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.


A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.


A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Engenheiro de controle
description:

title: Senior Cloud Administrator
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world


This role will cover our open B (4PM - 12PM) shift.


Position Summary : The Senior Cloud Administrator is responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, and management of the organization's cloud infrastructure. This role involves ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of cloud-based systems, as well as providing technical support and guidance to other team members.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Cloud Infrastructure Management : Manage and monitor day-to-day IT cloud infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Design and Implementation : Design and implement cloud systems and platforms in accordance with company security guidelines and best practices.
  • Security and Compliance : Ensure the integrity and security of cloud infrastructures by monitoring access, usage, and resources, and ensuring compliance with industry standards.
  • System Backups and Recovery : Perform system backups and recovery to ensure data integrity and availability.
  • Troubleshooting : Install, configure, and troubleshoot cloud services and applications, and analyze system logs to identify and resolve issues.
  • Resource Optimization : Ensure efficient utilization of cloud resources, including CPU, memory, and storage.
  • Collaboration : Work closely with IT security and other teams to define and implement cloud strategy, architecture, and services.
  • Training and Support : Educate teams on the implementation of new cloud-based initiatives and provide technical support for cloud applications and services.
  • Documentation : Maintain comprehensive documentation of cloud infrastructure, configurations, and procedures.
  • Vendor Management : Evaluate and manage relationships with cloud service providers to ensure they meet organizational needs.
  • Performance Optimization : Continuously monitor and optimize cloud performance to ensure minimal downtime and efficient resource utilization.
  • Disaster Recovery : Develop and implement disaster recovery plans for cloud systems.


Qualifications :

  • Experience : At least 6 years of experience in cloud administration, including managing and optimizing cloud resources.
  • Skills : Strong knowledge of cloud computing technologies, such as AWS, Azure, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Proficiency in scripting and automation tools (e.g., PowerShell, Terraform).
  • Education : Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Certifications : Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or Oracle Cloud Certified Architect are highly desirable.


Desired Attributes :

  • Problem-Solver : Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to resolve technical issues efficiently.
  • Team Player : Collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams.
  • Detail-Oriented : Keen attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high standards of security and compliance.
  • Adaptable : Ability to operate independently and adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

description:
About the Business Division:

Since our inception in 2013, Remedium have championed the recruitment of permanent healthcare professionals, supporting our clients to drive more efficient and consistent patient-led care, address future healthcare workforce staffing demands and reduce excessive agency locum spend. We are well and truly the leading provider in this sector and the innovators in the marketplace. We are the experts and are here to share our knowledge and expertise with you!

Job Description

We are seeking an Arabic-speaking Inside Sales Representative (Intern/Entry Level) to support outbound business development efforts across hospitals and healthcare systems in Arabic-speaking countries. This role focuses on prospecting and cold outreach to hospital administrators and healthcare leadership to schedule meetings for our senior sales team regarding physician recruitment services.

This position is well-suited for individuals interested in international healthcare sales, business development, or medical services partnerships . The primary objective is to generate qualified meetings with hospital decision-makers .

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound calls and email outreach to hospitals and healthcare organizations in Arabic-speaking countries.
  • Identify and connect with hospital administrators and hospital decision-makers .
  • Introduce the company’s physician and clinical staffing service offerings .
  • Qualify prospects and schedule meetings for senior sales representatives.
  • Maintain accurate records of outreach activity in the CRM system .
  • Meet defined call, outreach, and meeting-setting targets .
Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent in Arabic and business-level in English (spoken and written)
  • Strong verbal communication and professional phone presence
  • Interest in sales, business development, or healthcare services
  • Ability to confidently conduct cold outreach and lead qualification
  • Organized with strong follow-up and time management skills

Preferred

  • Prior sales, telemarketing, or customer outreach experience
  • Background or coursework in business, healthcare administration, or international business
  • Familiarity with healthcare systems or hospital operations

What You’ll Gain

  • Training in sales prospecting, lead qualification, and meeting generation
  • Hands-on experience in international healthcare sales
  • Exposure to hospital operations and physician service solutions
  • Opportunity to work with a global healthcare services team
  • Potential pathway to a full-time sales or business development role

Key Metrics for Success

  • Outbound call volume

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Confident communicator comfortable speaking with hospital leadership
  • Interested in global healthcare markets

About M3 EU:

M3 EU is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fuelled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 EU prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 EU means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 EU.

title: Remote Kotlin / Java Backend Developer
description:
At Scanz, we are on a mission to bring magic back to trading software - specifically for active traders (aka day traders). To empower traders to do their best trading, we are building a next-generation Trader Analytics Platform that combines UI elegance with world-class real time performance. Founded in 2004, Scanz has become the platform of choice for 40,000+ traders to identify, plan and make their trades.


Scanz is a fully remote company. Today, our small but mighty team is distributed across North America, South America, Europe and Australia. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and our passion for software craftsmanship. We care deeply about the quality of our work.


As a very small team, we’re all generalists and constantly picking up new challenges. When it comes to code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick a problem and solve it. We use Kotlin, TypeScript and React to build a highly-scalable system so we can continuously make progress on a solid foundation. We don’t expect you to have a background in everything we use, but we do expect strong Java fundamentals (Kotlin even better) and a background working with React and TypeScript.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement server-side logic using Spring Webflux and Kotlin.
  • Build robust, reliable, fault-tolerant data pipelines that process millions of operations daily.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.
  • Develop and maintain APIs, ensuring high performance and responsiveness.
  • Contribute to database design and implementation (PostgreSQL).
  • Improve the system's throughput and incorporate performance testing into our CI pipelines.
  • Scale services horizontally.
  • Contribute to weekly standup.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin / Java.
  • Proficiency with Kotlin coroutines (flows).
  • Proficiency with Spring Webflux and Reactive Streams back pressure.
  • Self-motivated developer comfortable working as a core member on an A-list team of backend and frontend developers split over different time zones.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills within an asynchronous environment (Slack, Loom).
  • Deep-level understanding of distributed systems and how to make fault-tolerant applications.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Strong familiarity with database systems, particularly PostgreSQL.
  • Comfortable using AWS and cloud computing platforms.
  • Solid understanding of the testing pyramid, specifically unit, integration, and E2E tests.
  • Readiness and desire to participate in code reviews.
  • We're hiring across Americas and European time zones


Tech Stack

Back End

  • Kotlin
  • Spring Webflux
  • Ktor Server
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • RSocket
  • Ktor Client
  • Kotlinx Serialization
  • Quartz
  • Kotest + JUnit
  • Gradle


Front End

  • Kotlin Multiplatform
  • React (with hooks)
  • SharedWorker
  • TypeScript
  • NPM
  • Gradle


Infrastructure

  • AWS + S3
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Jenkins
  • Github

title: Engenheiro (a) MLOps e LLMOps
description:
Com 70 anos de existência, o Einstein Hospital Israelita ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação em setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como MLOps/LLMOps para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, machine learning tradicional e IA generativa. A pessoa será responsável por projetar, implementar e operar pipelines de ML end-to-end, garantindo que modelos e agentes de IA sejam implantados e monitorados em produção com alta confiabilidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

O papel envolve atuar tanto em MLOps, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de modelos treinados com dados proprietários, quanto em LLMOps, lidando com desafios específicos de LLMs, como versionamento de prompts, variabilidade de outputs, otimização de custos de inferência e monitoramento de alucinaçõe


Informações da vaga:

  • Local de trabalho: Unid Centro de Ens e Pesquisa (AECE)
  • Área: Planejamento Analytics
  • Diretoria : Digital
  • Modelo de trabalho : Híbrido
  • Jornada de trabalho : 220h/mês


Responsabilidades:

MLOps (IA Tradicional)

  • Projetar e manter pipelines CI/CD para treinamento, validacao e deploy de modelos de ML (MLflow,
  • Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines)
  • Implementar IaC para ambientes de ML em cloud (GCP primario), incluindo GPU provisioning e
  • autoscaling
  • Construir e gerenciar feature stores, model registries e pipelines de dados para treinamento
  • Monitoramento de modelos em producao: data drift, concept drift, performance degradation (Evidently,
  • Whylogs, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Garantir reproducibilidade de experimentos com versionamento de dados (DVC, lakeFS) e modelos

LLMOps (IA Generativa & Agentic AI)

  • Operar e otimizar serving de LLMs (vLLM, TGI, Triton) com foco em latencia, throughput e custo
  • Desenvolver pipelines de RAG end-to-end: ingestao, chunking, embedding, vector stores (Pinecone,
  • Weaviate, pgvector, Qdrant)
  • Versionamento de prompts, avaliacao sistematica de saidas (evals) e A/B testing de configuracoes de LLM
  • Gerenciar custo de inferencia: caching inteligente, routing entre modelos, otimizacao de tokens e batching
  • Construir infraestrutura para agentes autonomos (AgentOps): orquestracao, observabilidade, guardrails e
  • circuit breakers
  • Guardrails de seguranca para LLMs: content filtering, PII detection, compliance LGPD/HIPAA

Transversal

  • Governanca, seguranca (RBAC, auditoria) e compliance regulatorio em todo o ciclo de vida
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de software e times de produto
  • Documentar padroes, runbooks e boas praticas para escalar o conhecimento no time


Requisitos

Imprescindíveis:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em MLOps, ML Engineering ou Data/Platform Engineering, com foco em ambientes de produção
  • Solida experiência em implantação de modelos de ML em produção (não apenas em experimentação ou notebooks)
  • Experiência em práticas com workloads de IA generativa (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning ou agentes)
  • Python avançado e proficiência em frameworks de ML (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost)
  • Containers e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (GKE/EKS), Helm
  • Cloud: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Artifact Registry) ou equivalente AWS/Azure
  • IaC: Terraform, Pulumi ou CloudFormation
  • CI/CD para ML: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD
  • Plataformas de ML: MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines ou Metaflow
  • APIs de LLM e frameworks GenAI: OpenAI API, Anthropic API, LangChain, LlamaIndex
  • Git avançado, versionamento de dados (DVC, lakeFS) e versionamento de modelos
  • Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, Evidently AI ou Whylogs

Desejáveis:

  • Experiencia com fine-tuning de LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT) e alinhamento (RLHF/DPO)
  • Serving de modelos em GPU com otimizacao (quantizacao, batching dinamico, vLLM, TensorRT)
  • Pipelines de RAG em producao: embeddings, reranking, vector databases em escala
  • Evals e benchmarks sistematicos para LLMs (ragas, deepeval, promptfoo)
  • Orquestracao de agentes de IA (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen ou similares)

title: Especialista de People Analytics
description:
PROPÓSITO DO CARGO

Liderar a estratégia de dados e análises voltadas a pessoas, transformando dados de RH em insights acionáveis que suportem decisões de negócio sobre força de trabalho, retenção, desempenho e planejamento de capital humano.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter modelos analíticos e dashboards que traduzam dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para a liderança e área de negócio.
  • Conduzir análises preditivas e descritivas sobre temas como rotatividade (turnover), absenteísmo, desempenho, engajamento e produtividade.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico da área de Gestão de Pessoas, apoiando iniciativas de transformação cultural, desenvolvimento organizacional e gestão de talentos baseadas em dados.
  • Liderar projetos de estruturação de bases de dados e governança de dados de RH, garantindo qualidade, integridade e segurança das informações.
  • Colaborar com TI, Finanças e áreas de negócio na integração de dados e no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas end-to-end.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, apresentações executivas e materiais de storytelling com dados para C-level e lideranças sênior.
  • Coordenar a implementação e evolução de ferramentas de BI e plataformas de analytics (ex.: Power BI, Tableau, Workday Analytics, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Definir e monitorar KPIs e OKRs da área de pessoas, propondo ações corretivas com base em tendências identificadas.
  • Realizar benchmarks de mercado sobre práticas de People Analytics e recomendar inovações e melhorias de processo.
  • Orientar e desenvolver analistas da equipe em boas práticas de análise de dados, modelagem e visualização.


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Economia, Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização em People Analytics, Gestão de Pessoas, Data Science ou Business Intelligence será considerado diferencial.


CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS REQUERIDOS

Análise de Dados e Estatística

  • Conhecimento sólido em métodos estatísticos aplicados a RH: regressão, clustering, análise de sobrevivência, séries temporais.
  • Domínio de linguagem Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.
  • Proficiência em SQL para extração e manipulação de dados em bancos relacionais.

Business Intelligence e Visualização

  • Experiência comprovada em ferramentas de BI: Power BI, Tableau ou similares — incluindo criação de relatórios, dashboards e modelagem de dados.
  • Habilidade na construção de storytelling com dados para públicos executivos.

Sistemas de RH (HRIS)

  • Familiaridade com sistemas de RH como SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, TOTVS RH, Oracle HCM ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em APIs e integração de dados entre sistemas de RH e plataformas analíticas.

People Analytics e RH Estratégico

  • Experiência em análise de dados de workforce: headcount, turnover, absenteísmo, time-to-hire, NPS interno, remuneração e benefícios.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks como Workforce Planning, HR Scorecard e OKRs de pessoas.
  • Entendimento do ciclo completo de gestão de talentos: atração, desenvolvimento, engajamento e retenção.

Competências Comportamentais Diferenciadoras

  • Raciocínio analítico e pensamento crítico orientado a dados.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para traduzir análises complexas em linguagem de negócio.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de influenciar decisões com base em evidências.
  • Autonomia, proatividade e capacidade de gestão de múltiplos projetos simultâneos.


EXPERIÊNCIA DESEJADA

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, sendo ao menos 2 anos em People Analytics ou área correlata de RH.
  • Experiência em empresas de médio ou grande porte com culturas orientadas a dados.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou evolução de sistemas HRIS será considerada diferencial.

title: Assistente de manutenção
description:
Resumo das atividades


Foco em Manutenção Residencial .

  • Executar manutenção corretiva elétrica, mecânica e hidráulica em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, atendendo solicitações internas e de moradores, diagnosticando defeitos, através de manuais, desenhos e/ou avaliação técnica, substituindo peças e efetuando os ajustes necessários;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva (mecânica, elétrica e hidráulica) baseando-se em checklist, inspecionando equipamentos de sistemas de refrigeração, funcionamento de bombas, caixa d’água, parte elétrica, geradores etc., detectando possíveis irregularidades, executando os reparos e informando o superior sobre os problemas detectados;
  • Utilizar, ferramentas e equipamentos apropriados para cada tipo de atividade, inclusive trabalhos em altura, fazendo uso dos acessórios de segurança exigidos, conforme legislação vigente;
  • Cuidar da segurança dos usuários, residentes e funcionários, durante a execução dos serviços de manutenção;
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos moradores e demais usuários, realizando manutenção corretiva/preventiva nos apartamentos;
  • Acompanhar leitura e registrar o consumo diário de gás, água e energia;
  • Inspecionar os equipamentos de combate a incêndio;
  • Solicitar e acompanhar visita técnica e manutenção realizada por terceiros;
  • Cumprir procedimentos relativos ao uso de EPI e EPC;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados nos serviços de manutenção, requisitando sua reposição quando necessário;
  • Orientar profissionais de menor nível de experiência assim como fornecedores;
  • Executar pequenos serviços de alvenaria e marcenaria, quando necessário;
  • Registrar as manutenções efetuadas e todos os atendimentos realizados a moradores;
  • Executar outras atribuições correlatas de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Liderar e coordenar equipe de brigadistas, realizar ações de treinamento e procedimentos para o Edifício.
  • Controlar o estoque de materiais, peças, componentes, ferramentas e equipamentos, verificando quantidades e registrando em documentos e planilhas sua movimentação;


Qualificação

Ensino médio completo;

Desejável superior ou técnico em elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, hidráulica;

Curso de NR10.


Habilidades

Capacidade resolutiva;

Comunicar-se de forma inclusiva e eficaz diante um público multicultural e amplamente conectado;

Organização para arquivar informações de maneira correta;

Proatividade em executar as manutenções.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte


Horário de trabalho:


  • De segunda à sexta-feira

title: Level 1 Support Specialist
description:
Level 1 IT Support Specialist (SAP Experience Required)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract - 3 months initially

Daily Rate: €60 – €70 per day

Job Overview

We are looking for a Level 1 IT Support Specialist to join our team and provide first-line technical support to end users. The ideal candidate will have basic experience with SAP systems and a strong customer-focused mindset. You will be responsible for handling initial support requests, troubleshooting common issues, and escalating more complex problems when necessary.


  • Provide first-level technical support via phone, email, or ticketing system
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic IT and SAP-related issues
  • Log, track, and manage support tickets in the system
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Level 2 support teams
  • Assist users with SAP login issues, navigation, and basic functionality
  • Maintain accurate documentation of issues and resolutions
  • Follow standard support procedures and service level agreements (SLAs)


Requirements

  • Basic experience working with SAP (any module is a plus)
  • Previous experience in IT support, helpdesk, or customer service role preferred
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Basic knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft Office, and common IT tools
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • High level of English


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk)
  • Understanding of ITIL principles
  • Multilingual skills (if applicable)

title: After-sales Service Manager

title: Presales Engineer
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position:

We are looking for a Pre-Sales Engineer to join our global Revenue team! Based in São Paulo, Brazil , this individual will play a crucial role in showcasing the value of Optibus’ solutions to potential clients, including transportation providers and public transport authorities (PTAs) across LATAM. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to engage with prospective customers and help them navigate the challenges they face in optimizing public transportation. This is a hybrid role with a minimum of 3 days per week in the regional office/on-site with clients and will involve occasional travel (approximately 20%) within LATAM.

Responsibilities:

Client Engagement :

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to potential clients, building strong relationships with stakeholders and delivering tailored solutions to meet their transportation needs.
  • Conduct in-depth discovery sessions to understand client requirements and present how Optibus can address their business challenges with AI and optimization solutions.


Solution Demonstration & Education :

  • Become an expert in Optibus products and solutions, delivering impactful demonstrations, proofs of concept, workshops, and value assessments.
  • Help clients understand the full value of the platform, addressing technical queries and providing guidance throughout the evaluation process.


Collaboration & Strategy :

  • Work closely with Sales Executives to strategize and execute deals in rapid sales cycles, contributing to RFIs/RFPs and account strategy discussions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Product and Customer Success, to ensure smooth transition of client insights, facilitating successful implementation and customer satisfaction.


Market Leadership :

  • Develop deep expertise in the UK market and foster relationships with key industry stakeholders, including Public Transport Authorities (PTAs) and Public Transport Operators (PTOs).
  • Represent Optibus at industry events, webinars, and conferences to enhance brand visibility and demonstrate thought leadership in the public transport space.


Feedback & Continuous Improvement :

  • Collect client feedback to inform Product Management and Engineering teams, helping to shape product offerings and improve customer experience.
  • Support integration discussions and API implementations, ensuring smooth handovers to the Customer Success team for post-sale support.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience : Minimum of 3 years in a pre-sales, solution engineering, or consulting role, ideally within SaaS, public transport, or related industries.
  • Strong technical acumen : Ability to communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Project management skills : Experience managing multiple time-sensitive projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, start-up or scale-up environment.
  • Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Portuguese and Spanish with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Collaboration : Demonstrated ability to work in a cross-functional team environment, collaborating closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams.
  • Please submit your CV in English for consideration!


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.


Interview process:

  • Initial screening with Talent Acquisition team
  • Team Lead Interview with Pre-Sales Team Lead (30 mins)
  • Manager Interview with Pre-Sales Manager (30 mins)
  • Case study interview with Pre-Sales Team Lead, Global Director of Pre-Sales and Pre-Sales Manager (60 mins)

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.

title: Golden Visa & Citizenship Advisor – Latin America
description:
Remote | Report to Athens HQ

Independent Contractor

Uncapped commission - top performers earn €100,000–€200,000+


Who We Are


We believe ambitious people should not be prisoners of their passport.


PassBeyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure European residency and citizenship through Greek property investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families - gaining Schengen access, euro-denominated assets, and long-term optionality.


Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. PassBeyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.


We’re looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from India and South Asia.


The Role


This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals - and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.


You will:


• Introduce PassBeyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network

• Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks - so they can make an informed decision

• Walk alongside clients from first conversation through to permit in hand

• Build trust through genuine conversation - not scripts or pressure tactics

• Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters


We’re not looking for cold-callers or lead-chasers. We’re looking for trusted connectors.


Who Our Clients Are


• Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest

• Self-made successes who built wealth through talent and persistence

• Often from environments where institutions have failed them - they’re sceptical for good reason

• Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families

• They value relationships over transactions and won’t be rushed or pressured


Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their scepticism, and guides with patience and honesty.


What We’re Looking For


Essential:


• Existing relationships with HNWIs in LATAM

• Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you’d serve

• Fluent English (written and verbal)

• Comfortable with commission-only compensation

• Integrity - you’d rather lose a deal than mislead someone


Highly Desirable:


• Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

• Active LinkedIn presence


Backgrounds that often do well:


• Business owners and entrepreneurs

• Private bankers and wealth managers

• Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients

• Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets

• Community leaders and well-connected professionals

• Successful diaspora professionals in UK, UAE, Singapore, or Europe


What You Get


• Full training and certification on our programmes - no cost to you

• Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens)

• Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory - not generic sales scripts

• CRM system for pipeline management

• Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients

• Direct support from our Athens headquarters - legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you

• As we grow together, you’ll receive warm leads from our marketing campaigns alongside your own network


Our Values


Freedom - The right to become who you are capable of becoming - unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth.


Integrity - Not a character trait - an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.


Partnership - We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

title: Talent Acquisition Sr Analyst
description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.


We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).


To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.


Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.


About the team/role

As a member of the talent acquisition team, you'll have the opportunity to work in a cross-regional team with international exposure. We spot, engage and hire the top talents to join DiDi. We drive new growth opportunities for our teams by running talent programs, where our employees can expand their horizons globally.


In this role you will be...

  • Responsible to manage the full end-to-end hiring cycle for roles across multiple teams in the organization.
  • Acting as a strategic partner to business leaders; providing world-class market information, talent intelligence and key practices.
  • Owning the overall candidate experience through the hiring process until onboarding.
  • Using data to make decisions that facilitate hiring and allows the organization to make the best hiring decision.
  • Working with other HR teams to drive efficiencies and process improvements.
  • Working in projects that impact how we shape a culture of recruiting.


We are eager to be in touch with you because you have...

  • 3-4 years of experience in recruiting (preferably in a fast-paced environment such as the internet or consulting companies).
  • Experience using ATS systems (lever, greenhouse, icims, etc).
  • Strong verbal and written communication in English and spanish.
  • Excited about driving change and helping the organization evolve.
  • Knowledgeable about talent acquisition techniques (offer negotiation, sourcing, etc).


You‘ll love working at DiDi because:

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.


Diversity & Inclusion


Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.


We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.


This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.


We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Supervisor de Vendas - Shopping Serramar
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.


Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!


Tem habilidade para liderar e inspirar? Esta vaga é para você! Você vai treinar e engajar a equipe, garantir um atendimento top e cuidar da gestão do estoque, levando nosso time a marcar golaços todos os dias.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


Você será responsável por executar e garantir a execução dos processos de venda do setor de calçados, prestando atendimento de qualidade e zelando pela satisfação do cliente, conforme nosso roteiro de atendimento.


Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:


  • Coordenar, acompanhar, treinar e orientar a equipe na realização das tarefas, garantindo que o padrão de atendimento seja seguido, fornecendo feedback diários com relação ao atendimento e ao desempenho, visando a melhoria contínua no alcance dos resultados.
  • Efetuar a gestão de estoque do setor, analisando o desempenho dos produtos, visando, assim, propor abertura e/ou adequação dos limites.
  • Realizar conferência qualitativa e quantitativa do setor, garantir que todos os produtos do setor estejam com preços marcados corretamente.
  • Realizar diariamente a reunião com o time e acompanhar o desempenho de acordo com as metas diárias, visando atingir os resultados propostos.

Fazer os acompanhamentos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros) com os atletas liderados, de acordo com normas e procedimentos internos.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES ✅ ✅


Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:


  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação


SOBRE A CENTAURO:


A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.


Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!


O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.


Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões

title: Desenvolvedor Flutter
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;

  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;

title: Talent Acquisition Analyst, Candidate Experience
description:
The Role

As a Talent Acquisition / Candidate Experience Analyst, you will play a critical role in driving an efficient and high-quality hiring experience. You will operate at the intersection of Candidate Experience and Talent Operations, ensuring that processes are scalable, data is accurate, and candidates and stakeholders have a seamless journey from application to hiring.


What You’ll Do

  • Own and optimize candidate experience, interview scheduling processes across teams, time zones, and formats, ensuring speed, accuracy, and a smooth experience.
  • Manage end-to-end interview logistics, proactively handling changes, minimizing delays, and ensuring alignment across all stakeholders.
  • Ensure timely and consistent candidate communication, improving transparency and overall experience throughout the hiring process.
  • Track and analyze recruitment data, maintaining accurate records and generating insights to support decision-making.
  • Support and execute Talent Operations initiatives, including process improvements, workflow optimization, and documentation of best practices.
  • Contribute to talent attraction programs and projects focused on enhancing candidate experience and operational efficiency.
  • Identify gaps in processes and propose practical solutions to improve scalability, consistency, and performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with recruiters, hiring managers, and operations teams to ensure alignment and execution excellence.


What We Need From You

  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting Operations, or similar analytical/operational roles.
  • Availability to work onsite 5 days per week at EZ Tower (Chácara Santo Antônio, near Morumbi train station) is required.
  • Proficiency in data handling and reporting using tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to translate data into insights and support process improvements.
  • Clear and effective communication skills, with strong stakeholder management capabilities.
  • High attention to detail and a proactive mindset to identify and resolve issues.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Must be comfortable communicating in English on a daily basis.


What Makes This Role Exciting

Opportunity to directly impact candidate experience at scale.

Exposure to both strategic and operational aspects of Talent Acquisition.

Involvement in process optimization and data-driven decision-making.

Cross-functional collaboration with high visibility across teams.

Opportunity to build scalable solutions and influence how hiring evolves.


Why Join Keeta

At Keeta, you’ll be part of a fast-growing global company where hiring is a key driver of success. This role offers the opportunity to combine operations and analytics to improve how we attract and hire talent. You will work in a dynamic environment, contribute to meaningful improvements, and grow your impact as the business scales.

title: Especialista em Novos Negócios e M&A
description:
Somos Atvos!


Na Atvos, produzimos e comercializamos etanol, açúcar VHP e energia elétrica a partir da cana-de-açúcar e da biomassa. Nossa energia vai além do negócio: está nas pessoas e no nosso jeito de ser. Com capacidade para abastecer mais de 60 milhões de carros com etanol, adoçar milhões de festas com nosso açúcar e levar energia para o bem-estar de mais de 20 milhões de pessoas, também somos destaque na emissão de CBIOs. Atuamos com responsabilidade, desenvolvendo comunidades, cuidando do meio ambiente e transformando vidas. Aqui na Atvos lideramos a transição energética para mover o mundo e transformar vidas.


Confira mais da nossa empresa pelo site:


#VemPraAtvos


Aqui, diversidade é essencial! Nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, com incentivo á participação de mulheres e PCDs.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Mapear, avaliar e desenvolver oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, atuando desde a identificação da tese até a recomendação de investimento e acompanhamento da implementação dos projetos.

• Estruturar e desenvolver business cases completos, incluindo análises técnico-financeiras, modelagem econômica e avaliação de viabilidade dos projetos.

• Construir modelos financeiros robustos, assegurando consistência das premissas, análises de sensibilidade e aderência às diretrizes estratégicas e econômico-financeiras da companhia.

• Conduzir análises de mercado, tendências setoriais, ambiente regulatório e políticas públicas, antecipando riscos e identificando oportunidades para o pipeline de novos negócios.

• Elaborar materiais executivos e apresentações estratégicas, traduzindo análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas para suporte à tomada de decisão do top management.

• Atuar em interface com múltiplas áreas internas (Comercial, Inteligência de Mercado, Jurídico, Regulatório, Engenharia, Operações, Tributário e Meio Ambiente), garantindo alinhamento e viabilização dos projetos.

• Participar de processos de diligência (due diligence), estruturação de parcerias e potenciais operações de M&A, apoiando análises e recomendações estratégicas.

• Acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos projetos até o FID (Final Investment Decision), garantindo que todas as frentes (financeira, jurídica, regulatória e operacional) estejam devidamente estruturadas.

• Apoiar o relacionamento com stakeholders internos e externos, incluindo parceiros, consultorias, entidades setoriais e potenciais investidores.

• Identificar riscos, testar cenários e propor alternativas estratégicas que maximizem valor e reduzam incertezas nos projetos.


Requisitos e qualificações:

• Formação em Economia, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

• Inglês avançado.

• Experiência mínima de 3 anos em áreas como investimentos, consultoria estratégica, planejamento estratégico, inteligência de mercado, financiamento de projetos ou FP&A.

• Experiência na estruturação de business cases, modelagem técnico-financeira e valuation.

• Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade para trabalhar com dados, testar cenários e desenvolver análises complexas.

• Capacidade de transformar análises técnicas em apresentações executivas claras e objetivas.

• Habilidade de comunicação, influência e articulação com diferentes áreas e níveis da organização.

• Experiência ou exposição a projetos de novos negócios, M&A ou corporate development será considerada um diferencial.

• Perfil proativo, com senso de dono, autonomia e visão estratégica.

• Capacidade de conduzir múltiplos projetos simultaneamente em ambientes dinâmicos e de alta complexidade.


Informações adicionais:

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido , com três dias presenciais por semana em nosso escritório em Pinheiros/SP. Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e conectado com o propósito de produzir energia limpa e renovável, impulsionando o futuro sustentável do país.

Na Atvos, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã . Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório.

description:

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);

  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;

  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;

title: Technical Solution Manager (Energy Storage)
description:
Key Responsibilities


1. Solution Design & Optimization

• Lead the design of energy storage solutions across grid-side, generation-side (renewable + storage), and standalone/shared energy storage power stations

• Analyze grid dispatch requirements and technical challenges in renewable grid integration


2. Tendering & Bidding Support

• Take the lead in large-scale energy storage project tenders

• Prepare technical proposals, including equipment selection, system topology design, and technical deviation analysis

• Ensure compliance, competitiveness, and technical excellence of proposals


3. Customized Project Development

• Evaluate system integration solutions for utility-scale storage projects

• Conduct electrical calculations and simulation analysis for various applications (frequency regulation, peak shaving, black start, etc.)

• Support sales teams in cost estimation and pricing strategy at project level


4. Full Lifecycle Technical Management

• Support project execution from design through construction and delivery

• Resolve technical issues related to electrical interfaces, communication protocols, and grid integration

• Provide technical support during operation & maintenance phases


5. Policy & Market Insights

• Track regional energy storage policies (capacity compensation, spot market rules, grid connection requirements, etc.)

• Analyze market dynamics and regional characteristics

• Contribute to white papers and technical roadmap reports for grid-side energy storage


6. Project Development Enablement

• Develop technical documentation such as:

• Utility-scale ESS development guidelines

• Grid connection FAQs

• Delivery & acceptance SOPs

• Deliver technical training to sales and project teams to accelerate commercialization


7. Competitive Analysis

• Benchmark leading competitors (e.g., Sungrow, HyperStrong)

• Conduct SWOT analysis and provide strategic insights

• Support product evolution in areas such as high-voltage cascade systems and liquid cooling technologies



Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Power Systems, Electrical Engineering, High Voltage Engineering, or related fields

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in the energy storage industry

• Proven experience supporting utility-scale (100MWh+) energy storage projects is preferred


Technical Expertise

• Strong knowledge of primary and secondary electrical design for energy storage systems

• Familiarity with protection systems, grid compliance testing, and SCADA/communication protocols

• Experience with power system analysis; proficiency in simulation tools such as PSCAD or ETAP is a plus


Soft Skills

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to represent the company in technical reviews with grid operators, EPCs, and clients


Documentation Skills

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Senior .NET Developer | Electronic Trading (CLT or PJ)


Let’s be clear from the start.


This role iS NOT about CRUD APIs, comfort zones, or hiding behind frameworks.

This is about building high throughput, low latency trading systems where every decision around threads, memory, and execution flow has real impact on money, markets, and performance.


You will join a greenfield initiative to build an electronic trading platform for Fixed Income products, used by a global trading business operating under constant pressure. The project has long term sponsorship, real technical ownership, and zero tolerance for weak engineering.


The platform is built from scratch with modern .NET and cloud native architecture, and the work goes deep into runtime behavior, concurrency, and resource management. If you enjoy understanding what happens under the hood, this is where you belong.


If you are looking for something safe, slow, or average, this is not for you.


What You Will Work On

You will spend your time building and optimizing backend services where advanced .NET concepts are used daily, not talked about theoretically.

This includes real production work with:

• Multithreading and thread synchronization

• Async and await internals and execution flow

• Garbage Collection behavior and memory allocation patterns

• Resource lifecycle management using IDisposable and manual disposal

• Concurrency control and race condition prevention

• Lock, Monitor, Mutex, and cross thread or cross process synchronization

• Designing services for high throughput and low latency workloads

• Applying threading and async patterns in market driven, time critical scenarios

You will work side by side with senior engineers and architects across multiple regions, influencing architecture, code quality, and technical standards.


Who We Want to Talk To

You are already senior. You have seen complex systems in production and you understand what breaks under load.

We are looking for people with:

• Strong hands on experience with .NET in backend systems

• Deep, practical experience with multithreading and asynchronous programming

• Solid understanding of the .NET runtime, memory management, and resource handling

• Experience building performance sensitive or low latency platforms

• Strong ASP.NET Core and API design experience

• Comfort working with large, long lived systems where mistakes are costly

• Experience with testing, CI/CD, and production grade engineering practices

If your experience stops at surface level abstractions, this will not be a fit.


Nice to Have

• Electronic trading or financial systems experience

• Fixed Income market knowledge

• AWS experience

• Proven track record improving performance, scalability, or system stability

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contract Manager para realizar a gestão estratégica de um portfólio de contratos pertencentes a um ou mais Projetos de Capital da empresa, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia. A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, atuando nos seguintes pilares:


  • Gerenciamento de riscos contratuais e de projetos;
  • Gestão de alterações contratuais (análise de mérito e valor para change order, Claim, back charge);
  • Gestão de conflitos (negociações, análise de cenários para tomada de decisão);

Responsabilidades:


  • Monitoramento e controle dos indicadores contratuais a nível contrato e projeto;
  • Gestão/mediação de negociações e conflitos;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da governança e procedimentos de gestão de contratos e riscos;

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão/administração de contratos e negociação;
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiências em gestão de riscos contratuais;
  • Habilidade de liderança, visão sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Recife - PE


Diferenciais:
